fields.statement: Verifier at 91fc3a3c: read the diff of internal/api/rex_install.go and rex_install_test.go. rexScript no longer takes a bin; rhiza.lua now writes `local BIN = "rhiza"` then `if type(settings.bin) == "string" and settings.bin ~= "" then BIN = settings.bin end` after the settings block, so a missing, empty or non-string bin leaves "rhiza" (Lua semantics; no interpreter on the host to execute it). The default settings block carries a commented-out bin entry. TestRexInstallScriptEntersTheKeyMode installs with ctx.Self="/opt/my tools/rhiza" and asserts that path appears nowhere in rhiza.lua; it then sets bin = "/home/me/go/bin/rhiza" and a new launch key in the settings block, reinstalls with ctx.Self="/elsewhere/rhiza", and asserts the file equals the edited bytes exactly and contains no "/elsewhere". TestRexInstallRoundTrip asserts a second install writes nothing and leaves rhiza.lua byte-identical. Ran `go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestRexInstall -count=1 -v` (all 9 PASS), `go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(rex-install|daemon-install)$' -count=1` (ok), gofmt -l and go vet on internal/api (clean).
